interpretation: The constructor's first descriptor dword 0x200 selects four heaps. The Linux source identifies S3000 0x0222 as QUYUAN1 family 0x0200; this is supporting cross-driver evidence for a four-heap profile, but the Windows descriptor field has not been proven identical to the Linux family mask. This does not validate PVZ map/unmap.
limits: Only the selector function ran; Windows kernel helpers were not executed.
The result is static Windows RM behavior, not a Guest hardware trial.
Windows Pci/BAR mapping is not treated as an implementation of Linux PVZ callbacks.
